title: Punishment for Unjust Land Seizure
summary: Unjustly taking land leads to severe consequences in the hereafter.
translation: From a Hadith, as narrated by Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (may Allah be pleased with her), the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Whoever unjustly takes even a span of land will have a collar from seven earths placed upon him on the Day of Judgment. In another Hadith, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, reportedly stated that whoever unjustly takes land or seizes it will be forced on the Day of Resurrection to carry the soil of that land on their head.
